'''2011 US Nationals Geoff Dearing LS Home One: War Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Geoff Dearing]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Home One: War Room|DS2-L-homeonewarroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Mastering Kenobi
* '''Username:''' gdearing
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
